notes: scan038.N1: The page continues a discussion of a complex analytic domain. It says X=C is topologically trivial and that its homotopy type is described by the topos of systems (17); (22) identifies the repeated F-form with C-hat. These claims were followed as background to reading, not independently proved.

scan038.N2: The definition of C has several author revisions: du is replaced by où dans le; a pi_1(Y) condition is rewritten; an implication ending iso) is inserted to the right; and a struck object-set description is replaced by {a,b}. The lower earlier version is retained in transcription despite its cancellation.

scan038.N3: The manuscript distinguishes the short curved pi forms of the inserted implication and lower condition from the tall straight Pi forms of A,B,C. This supports the alphabet readings from strokes; no expected group/groupoid distinction was used to overwrite clear ink.

scan038.N4: The inserted implication has a clear rightward arrow with a tilde, not a nondirectional equivalence sign. It has a visible closing parenthesis after iso and no independent opening parenthesis before D; the nearby descending stroke belongs to général. That imbalance is preserved.

scan038.N5: Local cancellations and the final block cancellation are distinct: short horizontal du/somme/actuel strokes; horizontal deletion of earlier object-set wording; local overstrikes in B and C; and two long thin diagonal strokes plus a left boundary across the lower block. No cancellation mark was recast as a diagram or as a textual symbol.

scan038.N6: Every one of the 22 principal baselines (including two display baselines) was visually read in the full-resolution halves against both witnesses. All interlinear additions and the pale foliation were separately inspected. The page layout was viewed once. Nineteen distinct crop files were inspected; four initially clipped unresolved boxes were enlarged before any decision on those features. No OCR, research, or other page was used.

scan038.N7: The two witnesses omit the visible colon before the lower display and the surviving comma after locally cancelled actuel. C duplicates the single comma at the old/new pi_1(Y) condition. These are recorded from ink, independently of grammar.

scan038.N8: The pale lower-left 37 is another hand's foliation, preserved as a margin annotation rather than author page numbering. H's long explanatory note is editorial and is excluded from the manuscript transcription.

scan038.N9: Mathematical coherence flags the overwritten B definition and the change from a union of object sets to {a,b} as places to inspect, but cannot settle their ink. The tentative B replacement by Y, the earlier heavily crossed wording, and the F typographical alphabet are explicitly left open for parent review.

scan038.N10: Parent supplied an independently established cote-level convention that the rounded hooked V family is mathcal V. The two clear local instances match it and are separately logged as r07b and r17b. Cancelled B/C instances retain explicit doubts. This reader did not inspect scan036 or any other page.

scan038.N11 Blind review retains the lower block as globally cancelled and preserves its local revisions. It opens a star/ell doubt on the inserted X exponent, admits a star in the earlier crossed C-argument, qualifies the compressed définies/définis ending, and marks locally crossed actuel uncertain. The final word morphismes is supported by its low m onset, descending p and following h/ismes strokes. These are readings from the crops, not repairs to the mathematics.
